help.title: How to create the Flex Query
help.create: In Interactive Brokers Client Portal open Performance & Reports, then Flex Queries, and create an Activity Flex Query.
help.sections: Add the sections Trades (with Executions selected), Cash Transactions and Open Positions.
help.format: Set the format to XML and the date format to yyyyMMdd.
help.period: Choose a period, for example Last 365 days, then save the query and run it to download the file.
help.token: For automatic sync, open Flex Web Service on the same page, enable it and copy the token.
help.queryId: The Query ID is the number shown next to the saved query.

connection.description: Jx Finance fetches the Flex Query once a day and imports whatever is new. The token is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
connection.queryIdError: The Query ID is the number shown next to your Flex Query.
connection.tokenHint: The number Interactive Brokers shows when you enable the Flex Web Service.
connection.tokenError: Enter the token as 6 to 64 digits.
connection.syncDailyHint: Turn off to keep the connection for manual syncs only.
connection.syncing: Fetching the report from Interactive Brokers. This can take up to a minute.
